name: [GANGS] San Diego Roleplay
desc:
🌴 Welcome to San Diego, California 🚔

🛠️ Live development - biweekly updates, your voice shapes the game

Roleplay game - respect the rules & respect other players or face moderation

How to Play:
🚙 Spawn your vehicle
🛂 Approach the city checkpoint
👮 Get approved or inspected by checkpoint authorities
💼 Sign up as an agent and run the line yourself
🚨 Or pack something you shouldn't and hope they don't look too close...

🎖️ Every team plays different - unique vehicles, uniforms, loadouts, and gear

If you use exploits/cheats to auto farm or cheat in any other way we WILL find you and you WILL be banned. You have been warned!
